title: add_slides
description: Insert SEVERAL new slides at once, one for each item, in order: a slide for each point of an outline, a section's slides. Each item is what that slide says; the application places it in its layout.

items.description: One slide: what it says (as add_slide's content), and its layout when you choose it.

points.description: The slide's points, in order, each a short line in your words (not a passage copied): a text, or {heading, text} for a point with a heading of its own (a column, a phase).

sources.description: The titles of the knowledge-base documents its text comes from: the application writes their citations in the slide's notes.

layout.description: A layout of this deck. Left out: the one its content fits.
The layout for every slide that names none. Left out: each the one its content fits.

after_slide_id.description: Put them after this slide (its number or ID). Left out: at the end.
